title: ack_always Sender retransmit_next can underflow when window wrapped
description:
## Location
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_always.rs lines 190-198

## Problem
The retransmission tile calculation:

```rust
let window_tiles = Self::WINDOW_SIZE.min(self.total_tiles - self.window as usize * Self::WINDOW_SIZE);
```

If `self.window` has wrapped past the valid range (due to the wrapping_add issue), then `self.window as usize * Self::WINDOW_SIZE` exceeds `self.total_tiles`, causing subtraction underflow.

## What Goes Wrong
- In debug mode: panics with arithmetic underflow
- In release mode: wraps to a huge value, `window_tiles` becomes enormous, and subsequent calculations produce out-of-bounds array access or corrupt data

## Relationship
This is a consequence of issue project-LICHEN-worker6-me8y.2 (window wrapping). Fixing that issue fixes this one.
close_reason: Added saturating_sub and bounds checks in retransmit_next to prevent underflow when window wrapped
